name: Signature Holo

components.pose: She stands with the staff in one hand and a glowing vial held up between two fingers of the other, her hair stirred by rising fumes, chin slightly lowered, a sly, knowing gaze straight to the camera; full figure visible.
components.expression: a sharp, calculating stare, a faint cunning smirk.
components.effects: Billows of luminous {{MAGIC}} venom mist roll across the floor, the alembics bubble over and glowing droplets float in the air, bursts of lime and magenta light flash from the flasks along the shelves.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Venomis, coiling through the vaulted laboratory behind her with its head lowered over her shoulder, toxic-orchid-magenta and tarnished-brass scales, wreathed in drifting toxic mist, wings like tattered sheets veined in vibrant acid-lime

notes: HOLO edition 'Venom Alchemist': the Signature scene re-authored with an ascended pose, upgraded signature weapon, crown, mantle, grander magic and a closer dragon. Holo shader/foil is applied in the client, not baked in.
